messages:
Linh (Docs): quick ask — I opened a PR that adds a lightweight 'Dedicated capacity onboarding' UX tutorial + flowchart and a tiny SDK snippet for provisioning. Can someone sanity-check the eviction/isolation wording and the YAML example? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423 :wave:
Kevin (Eng Docs): on it. linking Marc for runtime correctness re: eviction vs preemption @Marc :point_up:
Marc (Runtime): thanks — short technical note: runtime v2 standardized on the term `eviction` (not preemption). config key is `eviction_policy` and we expose `eviction_priority`. Docs should stop using 'preempt' as a noun. Also note that reserved pools can still trigger best-effort bursts — clarify in doc.
Linh (Docs): good — I'll change the wording. current YAML in PR is a simple example, please check:
```yaml
tenant: acme-inc
capacity_profile: reserved
reserved_pools:
  - name: gpu-large
    min_instances: 2
    max_instances: 10
    eviction_policy: graceful
    eviction_priority: low
```
Marc (Runtime): that looks fine, except `eviction_priority` values are `low|medium|high` (not strings with capitals). also we recently added `isolation_level` (values: `tenant|node|gpu`) for dedicated pools. maybe add a one-line note on isolation tradeoffs.
Aisha (Product): +1 on the isolation note. From product POV we need clear SLA wording for reserved vs burst: propose this phrasing — "Reserved capacity guarantees baseline throughput. Burst capacity is best-effort and subject to reserved pool availability and regional capacity constraints." Thoughts?
Kevin (Eng Docs): that's good and concise. I'd shorten: "Reserved capacity: guaranteed baseline. Burst: best-effort, subject to pool/regional availability." Might add a tooltip for 'best-effort' linking to the SLO table.
Linh (Docs): I'll use Kevin's shorter line and add a tooltip. Also planning to add a tiny Python SDK snippet to the onboarding tutorial to show creating a reserved pool. Draft:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
client.dedicated.create_pool(name="gpu-large", min_instances=2, max_instances=10, eviction_policy="graceful")
```
Kevin (Eng Docs): looks fine for a quickstart. Maybe include a TS snippet too for parity.
Linh (Docs): will add TS.
redwood-docs-bot: CI link check failed: `handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools.md` -> 404. Suggest update to `/handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools-guide.md` in PR.
Linh (Docs): ack — thanks bot. I'll fix links.
Marc (Runtime): small nuance: the flowchart's path that shows "fallback to hosted" should indicate fallback happens after `x` retries or latency spikes — else people think it's automatic. We do a routing policy check with `latency_slo` threshold. Suggest adding a tiny callout: "Fallback to hosted occurs when routing policy detects sustained SLO violation (see routing policy docs)."
Aisha (Product): and add a line about data controls — customers on Private may opt out of hosted fallbacks. Important for enterprise.
Kevin (Eng Docs): good point. can we add a note in the tutorial 'enterprise opt-outs' and link to Private deployment page?
Linh (Docs): yes, will add. I'll push an update to the PR today: replacing 'preemption' -> 'eviction', add `isolation_level` example, fix link to reserved-pools-guide, include Python + TS snippets, and add the flowchart callout + enterprise opt-out note.
Marc (Runtime): I'll skim the PR after you push and confirm the `eviction_priority` casing and the isolation descriptions. :thumbsup:
Aisha (Product): I'll review the SLA phrasing for marketing/oss alignment.
Kevin (Eng Docs): if anyone's free, please drop one short review comment so I can merge by EOD. I'm planning to squash commits and add a short changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md.
Linh (Docs): thanks all — assigning myself to update, ping me in-thread if something else needed.
Marc (Runtime): cool. FYI I left a short inline suggestion on the PR about adding an example of the `isolation_level: gpu` case (when a single tenant exclusively uses a GPU).
Linh (Docs): noted — will add that extra example and alt text for the flowchart (accessibility).
Kevin (Eng Docs): approved in principle, will give final LGTM after fixes. :raised_hands:
